item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00075","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C21","C04","C01"],"selected_candidate_label":"C21","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C21 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both letters use an official's visit to convey presidential greetings to a Latin American president-elect, praise the recent election as an affirmation of democratic institutions, connect it to bilateral friendship and cooperation, and close with wishes for success. C04 is another close congratulatory-accession letter but lacks the visiting-emissary and democratic-election structure. C01 shares the use of a visiting State Department official and bilateral-cooperation language, but not the election-congratulation function.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I am taking advantage of the official visit of Assistant Secretary of State Thomas C. Mann to convey to you my warm greetings and congratulations upon your election","parent_excerpt":"I am happy to take advantage of Vice President Nixon's presence in Bogota to extend through him my warm greetings to you","explanation":"Distinctive parallel use of a visiting senior official as the bearer of presidential greetings to a Latin American president-elect."},{"child_excerpt":"The elections conducted in your country on December 7 represent an important contribution to free and democratic institutions","parent_excerpt":"The recent expression of popular will in Colombia is gratifying to the world as indicative of the return of Colombia to constitutional processes of government, and your election as President of Colombia is heartening to all of us who cherish democratic political institutions.","explanation":"Both praise the recipient's election as an important affirmation of democratic or constitutional government."},{"child_excerpt":"The common devotion of our peoples to such institutions further strengthens our relations and provides a firm basis for our continuing friendship and cooperation.","parent_excerpt":"Undoubtedly such exchanges of views will serve to strengthen further the long and dose ties of friendship and cooperation that have linked the United States and Colombia.","explanation":"Closely parallel language ties the occasion to strengthened bilateral friendship and cooperation."},{"child_excerpt":"my best wishes for ... your success in the high office","parent_excerpt":"my best wishes for the success of your administration","explanation":"The letters conclude with materially similar wishes for the incoming president's success."}]}
